title: Ranges and NOT in products · part 4

steps.title: Keep price from 45.63 to 50.01
steps.prompt:
BETWEEN lo AND hi keeps a range (both ends included).
It is a tidy way to write two comparisons at once.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT id FROM products WHERE price BETWEEN 45.63 AND 50.01;
hints: Start with SELECT id FROM products.
Add WHERE price BETWEEN …
Write the two ends with AND between them.
Write: SELECT id FROM products WHERE price BETWEEN 45.63 AND 50.01;
steps.expected_sql: SELECT id FROM products WHERE price BETWEEN 45.63 AND 50.01;
steps.memory_trick: BETWEEN a AND b = a <= x <= b.

steps.title: Keep price outside 45.63..50.01
steps.prompt: NOT flips a test: NOT (something) means 'the opposite'.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT id FROM products WHERE NOT (price BETWEEN 45.63 AND 50.01);
hints: Start with SELECT id FROM products.
Wrap the range in brackets after NOT.
NOT ( price BETWEEN 45.63 AND 50.01 ).
Write: SELECT id FROM products WHERE NOT (price BETWEEN 45.63 AND 50.01);
steps.expected_sql: SELECT id FROM products WHERE NOT (price BETWEEN 45.63 AND 50.01);
steps.memory_trick: NOT reverses whatever is inside the brackets.
